items.text: NFL training camp injuries tracker: Latest updates on Ricky Pearsall, C.J. Gardner-Johnson and more. Pearsall is set to undergo season-ending knee surgery while Gardner-Johnson was injured during Saturday's Bills practice
Ricky Pearsall injury: 49ers receiver to undergo season-ending surgery on lingering PCL. Pearsall has been dealing with the issue since last season
49ers WR Ricky Pearsall is officially out for the 2026 season.

49ers WR Ricky Pearsall, who has been bothered by a PCL injury, is having surgery to repair the ligament, a procedure that ends his season, GM John Lynch announced. A frustrating outcome for SF. 

The 49ers signed WR Deebo Samuel with the thought that this could be the outcome. Now, reality.

Matt LaFleur: Tucker Kraft could participate in joint practice with Cardinals. Packers tight end Tucker Kraft was able to ride a bike to the practice field — and to practice on it — on Friday, his first work since suffering a torn ACL on November 2.
